preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200.
The number of nodes N and special nodes K must satisfy 1 <= K <= N <= 200000.
The node a must be a valid node within the range of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f_i <= N for f_i in f)
preconditions.description: All special nodes f_i must be valid nodes within the range of 1 to N.
There must be exactly K special nodes, and they must be distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= N and 1 <= v_i <= N for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid nodes within the range of 1 to N.
The number of edges must be exactly N - 1 to form a tree.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly 2 lines for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdout.splitlines()[:T])
postconditions.description: Each of the first T lines of output must contain N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdout.splitlines()[T:])
postconditions.description: Each of the last T lines of output must contain N space-separated integers.
